releases.notes:
**A trading noticeboard for Cobblemon servers.**

Post the Pokémon you're looking for and the ones you're giving away. When two players
want each other's Pokémon, both get a message and a button that opens Cobblemon's
normal trade screen.

- **Minecraft 1.21.1** · **Fabric** · needs **Cobblemon 1.7.3+**
- **Server-side only** — people joining your server don't install anything

## Installing

Put these in your server's `mods` folder:

1. `cobblemon-trade-exchange-1.0.0.jar` (this mod)
2. [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon) 1.7.3+ for 1.21.1
3. [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)

Fabric Language Kotlin is needed too, but Cobblemon already includes it.

See the [README](https://github.com/AymaanAreeb/cobblemon-trade-exchange#readme) for
the full command reference (`/pokewant`, `/pokehave`, `/poketrade`) and how matching works.
